head: 773fb98
method: Third independent subagent adjudicated from a packet with the FROZEN iq2c evaluation envelopes (must_notice/acceptable/unacceptable/must_not_invent), expected targets, before/after answers and both reviews; no source access. Criteria were not altered. Author (not independent) analysis of the two named cases is included separately.
comparability_finding: The earlier independent review judged the IQ-8B lead text; the latest review compared against the IQ-7 frozen baseline text and was given only the answer shape, not the frozen envelope. Two items (OMA-001:1, OSA-006:2) are therefore not comparable (INADEQUATE_EVIDENCE). Eleven are the same answer content judged more strictly (INTERPRETATION_DIFFERENCE). One is a genuine regression.

author_analysis.OSA-004:4: GENUINE REGRESSION introduced by IQ-8D: the old publicLead had an explicit approach/different branch; the projector port lost it and the COMPARISON held-fact branch assumes two named sides, so it answers "which of those suits you better". Owner: held-fact comparison projection (target has no two compare sides -> it is a difference question). Fix class: shared contract (comparison with <2 named sides).
author_analysis.CON-002:4: Not a new regression versus IQ-8B (the camera-as-reason flaw was already PARTIAL in the prior review). Owner: judgment limitation selection (targetedJudgment picks the FIRST not-available item instead of the one that matches the asked facet; temperature is in the device observed-values item). Fix class: select the limitation by overlap with the ask.
author_analysis.CON-009:1: DEGRADED: an empty device read whose capability said it could not load the inventory is projected as "There are no devices in what I read". Owner: envelope lacks an unavailable signal for an empty read; fix at the capability result (structured), not by parsing prose.

downgraded.reason: Before answer was counts only, so a prior MEETS citing 'leads named first' cannot have judged this text; after names leads (incl. routine ones) and is better.
Opens by saying nothing was ranked/recommended, which is the target; reviewers differ on whether it 'explains'.
Names the pair, states the comparison limit and gives each one's recorded facts; latest reviewer read the facts as contradicting the refusal.
States the limit but gives no recorded viability facts; identical to before, reviewers differ on PARTIAL vs DOES_NOT_MEET.
Says first that nothing was ordered, exactly the target; latest reviewer wanted a 'why'.
Says first that nothing was ranked so no reasoning changed; support line '0 records' is odd but unchanged.
After rewrites the question as 'which suits you better', a non sequitur to whether the approach differs; before at least did not mis-state the ask.
Opening gives only the to-check half; known facts are in the supporting detail, which equals the before text.
Before never named lease or JV so prior MEETS cannot match that text; after names both and declines to recommend, though wording is garbled.
Leads with the unverified safety report and says it cannot be confirmed (the target); no precaution step but not required by target.
Leads with known open items, scope limit follows in supporting detail; same content as before.
Leads with estate-wide facts, scope limit in supporting detail; same content as before.
Correct 'No' but cites camera state as the reason; the prior reviewer already flagged the same flaw as PARTIAL, latest as DOES_NOT_MEET. Temperature limitation is in the support.
Lists unconfirmable facts, not what would need confirmation; unchanged from before, only severity label differs.

does_not_meet.what_is_wrong: Generic refusal with no named items or recorded viability facts (consent/survey vs no feasibility evidence) although the facts were available a turn earlier.
does_not_meet.reason: A generic limit sentence wrote the answer and dropped the recorded facts the target requires.

does_not_meet.what_is_wrong: Answers 'which option suits you better' instead of whether the approach differs given the corrected Abuja location.
does_not_meet.reason: The ask was mis-shaped into a recommendation-choice target.

does_not_meet.what_is_wrong: Lists what is still needed from the user rather than what would be passed on and what is unverified; ignores callback proposal status.
does_not_meet.reason: The two-part handoff/verification target was replaced by a still-needed-fields target.

does_not_meet.what_is_wrong: Says No but gives camera state as the reason instead of that temperature/observed device values are unavailable.
does_not_meet.reason: A generic 'I don't have that - X not available' template took the first unavailable item rather than the one relevant to temperature.

does_not_meet.what_is_wrong: Lists what cannot be confirmed instead of which actions (e.g. turning the light off) would require confirmation, and that nothing executes or the proposal was cancelled.
does_not_meet.reason: The ask was routed to a status/evidence read instead of the action-confirmation/proposal state.
